103        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
104                
105                this.dialog = dialog;
106                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
107                
108                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
109                if (command == null) return false;
110                
111                memory = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
112                
113                entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
114                
115                String specId = entity.getCustomEntityType();
116                if (specId == null || entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE)) {
117                        specId = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE);
118                }
119                spec = SalvageEntityGeneratorOld.getSalvageSpec(specId);
120                
121                text = dialog.getTextPanel();
122                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
123                
124                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
125                cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
126                
127                playerFaction = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
128                entityFaction = entity.getFaction();
129                
130                Object test = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(MemFlags.SALVAGE_DEBRIS_FIELD);
131                if (test instanceof DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) {
132                        debris = (DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) test;
133                }
134                
135                if (command.equals("showCost")) {
136                        if (debris == null) {
137                                showCost();
138                        } else {
139                                //showCost();
140                                showCostDebrisField();
141                        }
142                } else if (command.equals("performSalvage")) {
143                        performSalvage();
144                } else if (command.equals("descDebris")) {
145                        showDebrisDescription();
146                } else if (command.equals("checkAccidents")) {
147                        checkAccidents();
148                } else if (command.equals("demolish")) {
149                        demolish();
150                } else if (command.equals("canBeMadeRecoverable")) {
151                        return canBeMadeRecoverable();
152                } else if (command.equals("blockRecoveryIfExtendedMode")) {
153                        return blockRecoveryIfExtendedMode();
154                } else if (command.equals("showRecoverable")) {
155                        showRecoverable();
156                }
157                
158                return true;
159        }

179        private float getAccidentProbability() {
180                if (debris == null) return 0f;
181                float accidentProbability = 0.2f + 0.8f * (1f - debris.getParams().density);
182                if (accidentProbability > 0.9f) accidentProbability = 0.9f;
183                return accidentProbability;
184        }
185        
186        private void checkAccidents() {
187                if (debris == null) {
188                        memory.set("$option", "salPerform");
189                        FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "DialogOptionSelected");
190                        return;
191                }
192                
193                float accidentProbability = getAccidentProbability();
194                //accidentProbability = 1f;
195                
196                long seed = memory.getLong(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED);
197                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed, 175);
198                
199                if (random.nextFloat() > accidentProbability) {
200                        memory.set("$option", "salPerform");
201                        FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "DialogOptionSelected");
202                        return;
203                }
204                
205                Color color = playerFaction.getColor();
206                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
207                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
208                
209                Map<String, Integer> requiredRes = computeRequiredToSalvage(entity);
210                float reqCrew = (int) requiredRes.get(Commodities.CREW);
211                float reqMachinery = (int) requiredRes.get(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY);
212
213                float crew = playerFleet.getCargo().getCrew();
214                float machinery = playerFleet.getCargo().getCommodityQuantity(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY);
215                float fCrew = crew / reqCrew;
216                if (fCrew < 0) fCrew = 0;
217                if (fCrew > 1) fCrew = 1;
218                
219                float fMachinery = machinery / reqMachinery;
220                if (fMachinery < 0) fMachinery = 0;
221                if (fMachinery > 1) fMachinery = 1;
222                
223                
224//              CommoditySpecAPI crewSpec = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.CREW);
225//              CommoditySpecAPI machinerySpec = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY);
226                
227                float lossValue = reqCrew * fCrew * 5f;
228                lossValue += (1f - debris.getParams().density / debris.getParams().baseDensity) * 500f;
229                lossValue *= 0.5f + random.nextFloat();
230                //lossValue *= StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(random, 0.5f, 1.5f);
231                
232                WeightedRandomPicker<String> lossPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
233                lossPicker.add(Commodities.CREW, 10f + 100f * (1f - fMachinery));
234                lossPicker.add(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, 10f + 100f * fMachinery);
235                
236                CargoAPI losses = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
237                float loss = 0;
238                while (loss < lossValue) {
239                        String id = lossPicker.pick();
240                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getCommoditySpec(id);
241                        loss += spec.getBasePrice();
242                        losses.addCommodity(id, 1f);
243                }
244                losses.sort();
245                
246                int crewLost = losses.getCrew();
247                if (crewLost > 0) {
248                        losses.removeCrew(crewLost);
249                        crewLost *= playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.NON_COMBAT_CREW_LOSS_MULT);
250                        if (crewLost < 1) crewLost = 1;
251                        losses.addCrew(crewLost);
252                }
253                
254                int machineryLost = (int) losses.getCommodityQuantity(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY);
255                if (crewLost > crew) crewLost = (int) crew;
256                if (machineryLost > machinery) machineryLost = (int) machinery;
257                
258                if (crewLost <= 0 && machineryLost <= 0) {
259                        memory.set("$option", "salPerform");
260                        FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "DialogOptionSelected");
261                }
262                
263                
264                for (CargoStackAPI stack : losses.getStacksCopy()) {
265                        cargo.removeCommodity(stack.getCommodityId(), stack.getSize());
266                }
267                
268                
269                
270                text.setFontInsignia();
271                text.addParagraph("An accident during the operation has resulted in the loss of ");
272                
273                if (crewLost <= 0) {
274                        text.appendToLastParagraph("" + machineryLost + " heavy machinery.");
275                        text.highlightInLastPara(highlight, "" + machineryLost);
276                } else if (machineryLost <= 0) {
277                        text.appendToLastParagraph("" + crewLost + " crew.");
278                        text.highlightInLastPara(highlight, "" + crewLost);
279                } else {
280                        text.appendToLastParagraph("" + crewLost + " crew and " + machineryLost + " heavy machinery.");
281                        text.highlightInLastPara(highlight, "" + crewLost, "" + machineryLost);
282                }
283                
284                
285                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("hit_solid", 1, 1, Global.getSoundPlayer().getListenerPos(), new Vector2f());
286                
287                options.clearOptions();
288                options.addOption("Continue", "salPerform");
289                //FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "PerformSalvage");
290                //FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "PerformSalvage");
291        }

294                if (debris == null) return;
295
296                float daysLeft = debris.getDaysLeft();
297                if (daysLeft >= 1000) {
298                        text.addParagraph("The field appears stable and will not drift apart any time soon.");
299                } else {
300                        String atLeastTime = Misc.getAtLeastStringForDays((int) daysLeft);
301                        text.addParagraph("The field is unstable, but should not drift apart for " + atLeastTime + ".");
302                }
303                
304//              boolean stillHot = debris.getGlowDaysLeft() > 0;
305//              switch (debris.getParams().source) {
306//              case BATTLE:
307//                      text.addParagraph("Pieces of ships, weapons, and escape pods litter the starscape.");

312//              case PLAYER_SALVAGE:
313//                      break;
314//              case SALVAGE:
315//                      break;
316//              }
317                
318//              if (stillHot) {
319//                      text.appendToLastParagraph(" Some of the pieces of debris are still radiating heat, making any salvage operations more dangerous.");
320//              }
321                
322                float lootValue = 0;

370        public static Map<String, Integer> computeRequiredToSalvage(SectorEntityToken entity) {
371                Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<String, Integer>();
372                
373                String specId = entity.getCustomEntityType();
374                if (specId == null || entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE)) {
375                        specId = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE);
376                }
377                SalvageEntityGenDataSpec spec = SalvageEntityGeneratorOld.getSalvageSpec(specId);
378                float mult = 1f + spec.getSalvageRating() * 9f;
379                
380                Object test = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(MemFlags.SALVAGE_DEBRIS_FIELD);
381                if (test instanceof DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) {
382                        DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin debris = (DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin) test;
383                        mult = getDebrisReqMult(debris);
384                }
385                
386                int crew = Math.round((int) (BASE_CREW * mult) / 10f) * 10;
387                int machinery = Math.round((int) (BASE_MACHINERY * mult) / 10f) * 10;
388                
389                result.put(Commodities.CREW, crew);
390                result.put(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, machinery);
391                
392                return result;
393        }

395        protected MutableStat getValueRecoveryStat(boolean withSkillMultForRares) {
396                Map<String, Integer> requiredRes = computeRequiredToSalvage(entity);
397                MutableStat valueRecovery = new MutableStat(1f);
398                int i = 0;
399                
400                float machineryContrib = 0.75f;
401                valueRecovery.modifyPercent("base", -100f);
402                if (machineryContrib < 1f) {
403                        valueRecovery.modifyPercent("base_positive", (int) Math.round(100f - 100f * machineryContrib), "Base effectiveness");
404                }
405                //valueRecovery.modifyPercent("base", -75f);
406                
407                float per = 0.5f;
408                per = 1f;
409                for (String commodityId : requiredRes.keySet()) {
410                        float required = requiredRes.get(commodityId);
411                        float available = (int) cargo.getCommodityQuantity(commodityId);
412                        if (required <= 0) continue;
413                        CommoditySpecAPI spec = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getCommoditySpec(commodityId);
414                        
415                        float val = Math.min(available / required, 1f) * per;
416                        int percent = (int) Math.round(val * 100f);
417                        //valueRecovery.modifyPercent("" + i++, percent, Misc.ucFirst(spec.getLowerCaseName()) + " requirements met");
418                        if (Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY.equals(commodityId)) {
419                                val = Math.min(available / required, machineryContrib) * per;
420                                percent = (int) Math.round(val * 100f);
421                                valueRecovery.modifyPercentAlways("" + i++, percent, Misc.ucFirst(spec.getLowerCaseName()) + " available");
422                        } else {
423                                valueRecovery.modifyMultAlways("" + i++, val, Misc.ucFirst(spec.getLowerCaseName()) + " available");
424                        }
425//                      float val = Math.max(1f - available / required, 0f) * per;
426//                      int percent = -1 * (int) Math.round(val * 100f);
427//                      valueRecovery.modifyPercent("" + i++, percent, "Insufficient " + spec.getLowerCaseName());
428                }
429                
430                boolean modified = false;
431                if (withSkillMultForRares) {
432                        for (StatMod mod : playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.SALVAGE_VALUE_MULT_FLEET_INCLUDES_RARE).getFlatMods().values()) {
433                                modified = true;
434                                valueRecovery.modifyPercentAlways("" + i++, (int) Math.round(mod.value * 100f), mod.desc);
435                        }
436                }
437                
438                {
439                        for (StatMod mod : playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.SALVAGE_VALUE_MULT_FLEET_NOT_RARE).getFlatMods().values()) {
440                                modified = true;
441                                valueRecovery.modifyPercentAlways("" + i++, (int) Math.round(mod.value * 100f), mod.desc);
442                        }
443                }
444                if (!modified) {
445                        valueRecovery.modifyPercentAlways("" + i++, (int) Math.round(0f), "Salvaging skill");
446                }
447                
448                float fleetSalvageShips = getPlayerShipsSalvageModUncapped();
449                valueRecovery.modifyPercentAlways("" + i++, (int) Math.round(fleetSalvageShips * 100f), "Fleetwide salvaging capability");
450                
451                return valueRecovery;
452        }

463        public void showCost() {
464                Color color = playerFaction.getColor();
465                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
466                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
467                
468                float pad = 3f;
469                float opad = 10f;
470                float small = 5f;
471                
472                Map<String, Integer> requiredRes = computeRequiredToSalvage(entity);
473                
474                text.addParagraph("You receive a preliminary assessment of a potential salvage operation from the exploration crews.");
475                
476                ResourceCostPanelAPI cost = text.addCostPanel("Crew & machinery: required (available)", COST_HEIGHT,
477                                color, playerFaction.getDarkUIColor());
478                cost.setNumberOnlyMode(true);
479                cost.setWithBorder(false);
480                cost.setAlignment(Alignment.LMID);
481                
482                for (String commodityId : requiredRes.keySet()) {
483                        int required = requiredRes.get(commodityId);
484                        int available = (int) cargo.getCommodityQuantity(commodityId);
485                        Color curr = color;
486                        if (required > cargo.getQuantity(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, commodityId)) {
487                                curr = bad;
488                        }
489                        cost.addCost(commodityId, "" + required + " (" + available + ")", curr);
490                }
491                cost.update();
492                
493                
494                MutableStat valueRecovery = getValueRecoveryStat(true);
495                
496                //rareRecovery.unmodify();
497                int valuePercent = (int)Math.round(valueRecovery.getModifiedValue() * 100f);
498                if (valuePercent < 0) valuePercent = 0;
499                String valueString = "" + valuePercent + "%";
500                Color valueColor = highlight;
501
502                if (valuePercent < 100) {
503                        valueColor = bad;
504                }
505                
506                TooltipMakerAPI info = text.beginTooltip();
507                info.setParaSmallInsignia();
508                info.addPara("Resource recovery effectiveness: %s", 0f, valueColor, valueString);
509                if (!valueRecovery.isUnmodified()) {
510                        info.addStatModGrid(300, 50, opad, small, valueRecovery, true, getModPrinter());
511                }
512                text.addTooltip();
513                
514                printSalvageModifiers();
515        }

517        protected StatModValueGetter getModPrinter() {
518                return new StatModValueGetter() {
519                        boolean percent = false;
520                        public String getPercentValue(StatMod mod) {
521                                percent = true;
522                                
523                                 // should make it not shown; it's a "base" value that has to be applied to make the calculations work with multipliers
524                                if (mod.desc == null || mod.desc.isEmpty()) return "";
525                                
526                                String prefix = mod.getValue() >= 0 ? "+" : "";
527                                return prefix + (int)(mod.getValue()) + "%";
528                        }
529                        public String getMultValue(StatMod mod) {percent = false; return null;}
530                        public String getFlatValue(StatMod mod) {percent = false; return null;}
531                        public Color getModColor(StatMod mod) {
532                                if ((!percent && mod.getValue() < 1f) || mod.getValue() < 0) return Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
533                                return null;
534                        }
535                };
536        }

538        protected void printSalvageModifiers() {
539                
540                float fuelMult = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.FUEL_SALVAGE_VALUE_MULT_FLEET);
541                String fuelStr = "" + (int)Math.round((fuelMult - 1f) * 100f) + "%";
542                
543                float rareMult = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.SALVAGE_VALUE_MULT_FLEET_INCLUDES_RARE);
544                String rareStr = "" + (int)Math.round((rareMult - 1f) * 100f) + "%";
545                
546                if (fuelMult > 1f && rareMult > 1f) {
547                        text.addPara("Your fleet also has a %s bonus to the amount of fuel recovered, and " +
548                                        "a %s bonus to the number of rare items found.",
549                                         Misc.getHighlightColor(), fuelStr, rareStr);
550                } else if (fuelMult > 1) {
551                        text.addPara("Your fleet also has a %s bonus to the amount of fuel recovered.",
552                                         Misc.getHighlightColor(), fuelStr);
553                } else if (rareMult > 1) {
554                        text.addPara("Your fleet also has a %s bonus to the number of rare items found.",
555                                         Misc.getHighlightColor(), rareStr);
556                }
557                
558                if (debris != null) {
559                        text.addParagraph("The density of the debris field affects both the amount of resources and the number of rare items found.");
560                } else {
561                        text.addPara("The recovery effectiveness does not affect the chance of finding rare and valuable items.");
562                }
563
564        }

566        public void showCostDebrisField() {
567                Color color = playerFaction.getColor();
568                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
569                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
570                
571                float pad = 3f;
572                float opad = 10f;
573                float small = 5f;
574                
575                Map<String, Integer> requiredRes = computeRequiredToSalvage(entity);
576                
577                //text.addParagraph("You receive a preliminary assessment of a potential salvage operation from the exploration crews.");

580                                color, playerFaction.getDarkUIColor());

627        protected float computeOverallMultForDebrisField() {
628                float overallMult = 1f;
629                if (debris != null) {
630//                      Map<String, Integer> reqs = computeRequiredToSalvage(entity);
631//                      float crewMax = 1f;
632//                      if (reqs.get(Commodities.CREW) != null) {
633//                              crewMax = reqs.get(Commodities.CREW);
634//                      }
635//                      float crew = playerFleet.getCargo().getCrew();
636//                      float f = crew / crewMax;
637//                      if (f < 0) f = 0;
638//                      if (f > 1) f = 1;
639//                      
640//                      //if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) f = 1f;
641                        
642                        float f = 1f;
643                        DebrisFieldParams params = debris.getParams();
644                        if (params.baseDensity > 0) {
645                                overallMult = params.density / params.baseDensity * f * FIELD_SALVAGE_FRACTION_PER_ATTEMPT;
646                        } else {
647                                overallMult = 0f;
648                        }
649                        if (overallMult < FIELD_MIN_SALVAGE_MULT) overallMult = FIELD_MIN_SALVAGE_MULT;
650                }
651                return overallMult;
652        }

921        public static float getDebrisReqMult(DebrisFieldTerrainPlugin field) {
922//              public static int FIELD_RADIUS_FOR_BASE_REQ = 200;
923//              public static int FIELD_RADIUS_FOR_MAX_REQ = 1000;
924//              public static int FIELD_RADIUS_MAX_REQ_MULT = 10;
925                float r = field.getParams().bandWidthInEngine;
926                float f = (r - FIELD_RADIUS_FOR_BASE_REQ) / (FIELD_RADIUS_FOR_MAX_REQ - FIELD_RADIUS_FOR_BASE_REQ);
927                if (f < 0) f = 0;
928                if (f > 1) f = 1;
929                
930                float mult = 1f + (FIELD_RADIUS_MAX_REQ_MULT - 1f) * f;
931                return mult;
932        }

937        public static CargoAPI generateSalvage(Random random, float valueMult, float overallMult, float fuelMult, List<DropData> dropValue, List<DropData> dropRandom) {
938                return generateSalvage(random, valueMult, 1f, overallMult, fuelMult, dropValue, dropRandom);
939        }
940        public static CargoAPI generateSalvage(Random random, float valueMult, float randomMult, 
941                        float overallMult, float fuelMult, List<DropData> dropValue, List<DropData> dropRandom) {
942                if (random == null) random = new Random();
943                CargoAPI result = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
944                
945                
946                if (Misc.isEasy()) {
947                        overallMult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("easySalvageMult");
948                }
949//              CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
950                
951                //overallMult = 1f;
952                
953//              float valueMultFleet = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.SALVAGE_VALUE_MULT_FLEET);
954//              float valueModShips = getPlayerShipsSalvageMod(salvageRating);
955                
956                // check dropRandom first so that changing the drop value by dropping off crew/machinery
957                // does not change the RNG for dropRandom
958                if (dropRandom != null) {
959                        for (DropData data : dropRandom) {
960                                //if (random.nextFloat() < data.valueMult) continue;
961                                
962                                int chances = data.chances;
963                                if (data.maxChances > chances) {
964                                        chances = chances + random.nextInt(data.maxChances - chances + 1);
965                                }
966//                              if (data.group.endsWith("misc_test")) {
967//                                      System.out.println("fewfwefwe");
968//                              }
969                                //WeightedRandomPicker<DropGroupRow> picker = DropGroupRow.getPicker(data.group);
970                                
971                                float modifiedChances = chances;
972                                modifiedChances *= overallMult;
973                                if (data.value <= 0) {
974                                        modifiedChances *= randomMult;
975                                }
976                                modifiedChances *= data.valueMult;
977                                float rem = modifiedChances - (int) modifiedChances;
978                                
979                                chances = (int) modifiedChances + (random.nextFloat() < rem ? 1 : 0);
980                                
981                                WeightedRandomPicker<DropGroupRow> picker = data.getCustom();
982                                if (picker == null && data.group == null) continue; // meant for custom, but empty
983                                if (picker == null) {
984                                        picker = DropGroupRow.getPicker(data.group);
985                                }
986                                
987                                Random innerRandom = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 5);
988                                //innerRandom = random;
989                                picker.setRandom(innerRandom);
990                                for (int i = 0; i < chances; i++) {
991//                                      if (random.nextFloat() > overallMult) continue;
992//                                      if (random.nextFloat() > data.valueMult) continue;
993                                        
994                                        DropGroupRow row = picker.pick();
995                                        if (row.isMultiValued()) {
996                                                row = row.resolveToSpecificItem(innerRandom);
997                                        }
998                                        
999                                        if (row.isNothing()) continue;
1000                                        
1001                                        float baseUnitValue = row.getBaseUnitValue();
1002                                        
1003                                        float qty = 1f;
1004                                        if (data.value > 0) {
1005                                                float randMult = StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(innerRandom, 0.5f, 1.5f);
1006                                                //qty = (data.value * randMult * valueMult * overallMult) / baseUnitValue;
1007                                                // valueMult and overallMult are considered in figuring out number of chances to roll
1008                                                qty = (data.value * valueMult * randMult) / baseUnitValue;
1009                                                qty = (int) qty;
1010                                                if (valueMult <= 0) continue;
1011                                                if (qty < 1) qty = 1;
1012                                        }
1013                                        
1014                                        
1015                                        if (row.isWeapon()) {
1016                                                float p = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_weaponSalvageDropFraction") : 1f;
1017                                                if (data.unaffectedByExtMode) p = 1f;
1018                                                if (random.nextFloat() >= p) continue;
1019                                                result.addWeapons(row.getWeaponId(), (int) qty);
1020                                        } else if (row.isFighterWing()) {
1021                                                float p = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_fighterSalvageDropFraction") : 1f;
1022                                                if (data.unaffectedByExtMode) p = 1f;
1023                                                if (random.nextFloat() >= p) continue;
1024                                                result.addItems(CargoItemType.FIGHTER_CHIP, row.getFighterWingId(), (int) qty);
1025                                        } else if (row.isSpecialItem()) { 
1026                                                if (Items.TAG_MODSPEC.equals(row.getSpecialItemId())) {
1027                                                        float p = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_hullmodSalvageDropFraction") : 1f;
1028                                                        if (data.unaffectedByExtMode) p = 1f;
1029                                                        if (random.nextFloat() >= p) continue;
1030                                                } else {
1031                                                        float p = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_specialItemSalvageDropFraction") : 1f;
1032                                                        if (data.unaffectedByExtMode) p = 1f;
1033                                                        if (random.nextFloat() >= p) continue;
1034                                                }
1035                                                if (Items.TAG_MODSPEC.equals(row.getSpecialItemId()) && 
1036                                                                result.getQuantity(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, 
1037                                                                                new SpecialItemData(row.getSpecialItemId(), row.getSpecialItemData())) > 0) {
1038                                                        continue;
1039                                                }
1040                                                result.addItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, 
1041                                                                new SpecialItemData(row.getSpecialItemId(), row.getSpecialItemData()), (int) qty);
1042                                        } else {
1043                                                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
1044                                                        if (!data.unaffectedByExtMode) {
1045                                                                if (!Commodities.PARTS.equals(row.getCommodity())) {
1046                                                                        float f = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_commoditySalvageDropFraction");
1047                                                                        qty *= f;
1048                                                                } else {
1049                                                                        float f = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_partsSpecialSalvageDropFraction");
1050                                                                        qty *= f;
1051                                                                }
1052                                                                if (qty < 1f) {
1053                                                                        if (random.nextFloat() < qty) qty = 1f;
1054                                                                }
1055                                                                qty = (int) qty;
1056                                                        }
1057                                                }
1058                                                result.addCommodity(row.getCommodity(), qty);
1059                                        }
1060                                }
1061                        }
1062                }
1063                
1064                
1065                if (dropValue != null) {
1066                        
1067                        for (DropData data : dropValue) {
1068                                //if (random.nextFloat() < data.valueMult) continue;
1069                                
1070                                float maxValue = data.value;
1071                                
1072                                // if value is 1, it's a "guaranteed pick one out of this usually-dropRandom group"
1073                                // so still allow it even if valueMult is 0 due to a lack of heavy machinery
1074                                // since dropRandom works w/ no machinery, too
1075                                if (data.value > 1) {
1076                                        maxValue *= valueMult;
1077                                }
1078                                
1079                                maxValue *= overallMult;
1080                                maxValue *= data.valueMult;
1081                                
1082                                float randMult = StarSystemGenerator.getNormalRandom(random, 0.5f, 1.5f);
1083                                maxValue *= randMult;
1084                                
1085                                
1086                                WeightedRandomPicker<DropGroupRow> picker = data.getCustom();
1087                                if (picker == null && data.group == null) continue; // meant for custom, but empty
1088                                if (picker == null) {
1089                                        picker = DropGroupRow.getPicker(data.group);
1090                                }
1091                                picker.setRandom(random);
1092                                float value = 0f;
1093                                int nothingInARow = 0;
1094                                while (value < maxValue && nothingInARow < 10) {
1095                                        DropGroupRow row = picker.pick();
1096                                        if (row.isMultiValued()) {
1097                                                row = row.resolveToSpecificItem(random);
1098                                        }
1099                                        if (row.isNothing()) {
1100                                                nothingInARow++;
1101                                                continue;
1102                                        } else {
1103                                                nothingInARow = 0;
1104                                        }
1105                                        //System.out.println(nothingInARow);
1106                                        
1107                                        float baseUnitValue = row.getBaseUnitValue();
1108                                        
1109                                        float qty = 1f;
1110                                        float currValue = baseUnitValue * qty;
1111                                        value += currValue;
1112                                        
1113                                        if (row.isWeapon()) {
1114                                                if (value <= maxValue) {
1115                                                        result.addWeapons(row.getWeaponId(), (int) qty);
1116                                                }
1117//                                      } else if (row.isHullMod()) {
1118//                                              if (value <= maxValue) {
1119//                                                      result.addHullmods(row.getHullModId(), (int) qty);
1120//                                              }
1121                                        } else if (row.isFighterWing()) {
1122                                                if (value <= maxValue) {
1123                                                        result.addItems(CargoItemType.FIGHTER_CHIP, row.getFighterWingId(), (int) qty);
1124                                                }
1125                                        } else if (row.isSpecialItem()) {
1126                                                if (Items.TAG_MODSPEC.equals(row.getSpecialItemId()) && 
1127                                                                result.getQuantity(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, 
1128                                                                                new SpecialItemData(row.getSpecialItemId(), row.getSpecialItemData())) > 0) {
1129                                                        continue;
1130                                                }
1131                                                result.addItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, 
1132                                                                        new SpecialItemData(row.getSpecialItemId(), row.getSpecialItemData()), (int) qty);
1133                                        } else {
1134                                                if (value <= maxValue) {
1135                                                        result.addCommodity(row.getCommodity(), qty);
1136                                                }
1137                                        }
1138                                }
1139                        }
1140                }
1141                
1142                
1143                float fuel = result.getFuel();
1144                if (fuelMult > 1f) {
1145                        result.addFuel((int) Math.round(fuel * (fuelMult - 1f)));
1146                }
1147                
1148                result.sort();
1149                
1150                return result;
1151        }

1154        public boolean blockRecoveryIfExtendedMode() {
1155                if (entity.getCustomPlugin() instanceof DerelictShipEntityPlugin) {
1156                        if (Misc.isExtended()) {
1157                                long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(entity);
1158                                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed, 11);
1159                                float prob = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_shipRecoveryWithStoryPointsFraction");
1160                                if (random.nextFloat() >= prob) return true;
1161                        }
1162                }
1163                return false;
1164        }
